title: Bring domain_schema_version under integrity
description: Objective: make a drifted domain_schema_version detectable instead of silently trusted. Register item 4 of 11 from task-963cf1d125134c6193b7af0e53deeac3 (2026-08-14 product audit; verified real, classified low). RE-MEASURED STILL OPEN at HEAD 192360e: the column is declared at packages/store/src/sqlite-schema-manifest.ts:200 as `domain_schema_version TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'moe-domain-schema/0'`, written at event-ledger-append.ts:100/:177, and read back at event-read-decode.ts:90 into `domainSchemaVersion`. It then drives real decisions - projections/projection-upcast.ts:124 refuses SCHEMA_VERSION_UNSUPPORTED and :127 uses it as the upcast starting version - yet nothing binds the stored value to any digest or integrity check, so an altered column changes upcast behavior with no detection. FIRST STEP MUST CONFIRM THE GAP: grep the event digest/canonical input construction and record whether domainSchemaVersion participates; if it already does, this item is closed and the task should be closed rather than implemented. Deliverable: bind the stored schema version to the row's existing integrity mechanism so drift is detected and refused with an exact code and layer. NOT in scope: adding a new schema version, changing the upcast registry, or altering the projection fold contract. Verification: pnpm --filter @moe/store typecheck && pnpm --filter @moe/store test.
definitionOfDone: The gap is confirmed or refuted on current bytes FIRST, with the command and result recorded: if domainSchemaVersion already participates in the event digest or an equivalent integrity check, the task is closed as already-fixed rather than implemented.

If open: a stored domain_schema_version that no longer matches the value covered by the row's integrity mechanism is detected on read and refused with an exact stable reason code and layer - never silently upcast from the altered value.
The detection test mutates the stored column directly in the database and asserts the exact refusal code, proving detection rather than asserting that the happy path still works.
Existing SCHEMA_VERSION_UNSUPPORTED behavior and the upcast path for legitimately-versioned rows are unchanged; digests for unchanged rows are identical to before.
Fresh pnpm --filter @moe/store typecheck && pnpm --filter @moe/store test exits 0.
taskRails: If binding the column changes any existing event digest, that is a durable-format change and must be raised rather than landed silently - a digest change invalidates existing evidence.
A drifted value must fail closed. Never fall back to the DEFAULT 'moe-domain-schema/0' when the stored value fails its check; that would convert tampering into a supported version.
The test must alter the stored bytes, not the in-memory object, or it proves nothing about durable drift.
Target <=250 physical lines per production source; split before 400.
reopenReason: DECLINED AS WRITTEN by human decision 2026-08-15T16:00Z — transit hop only, archiving immediately. BLOCKED -> ARCHIVED is not an allowed transition, so this passes through BACKLOG. DO NOT CLAIM. Rationale recorded in comment-91bee5c7d6ea4111aeedaeaaf4f01185 and comment-6ceebe833621426884c9f21be7b4aa17: register item 4's premise does not hold — domain_events has no row-level integrity on any column, so there is no mechanism domain_schema_version escaped and nothing to bind it to, and protecting one column would create the appearance of integrity without the substance (epic rail 4). task-963cf1d1 reconciles as 8 created + 1 declined.

comments.author: architect-2aea4111
comments.content:
FULL MEASUREMENT behind the block (the block reason is capped at 2000 chars). Measured at HEAD 192360e.

I raised this slice myself from the audit register and explicitly flagged that I had not confirmed whether domainSchemaVersion participates in any integrity mechanism. Confirming it changed the answer, so this is a correction to my own slice rather than a defence of it.

FINDING 1 — domain_events has NO row-level integrity mechanism at all.
Columns per sqlite-schema-manifest.ts: event_id, aggregate_id, aggregate_sequence, command_id, command_event_index, record_version, payload_codec_version, request_sha256, event_type, payload, metadata, committed_at, domain_schema_version. There is no row digest, checksum, or HMAC column. `request_sha256` covers the REQUEST bytes, not the row. A grep for row_digest|event_digest|checksum|hmac|integrity across packages/store/src surfaces only PRAGMA integrity_check in a test helper and sqlite-schema-integrity.ts.

FINDING 2 — the one integrity mechanism that exists is about the SCHEMA, not rows.
validateSchema (sqlite-schema-integrity.ts:20) calls validateSchemaManifestMetadata against SQLITE_SCHEMA_MANIFEST_VERSION. That validates the DDL shape. It says nothing about the VALUES in any row.

CONSEQUENCE: the register's phrasing — "domain_schema_version sits outside every integrity mechanism" — is literally true but misleading, because so is every other column of the table. The wording implies this column escaped a mechanism the others are under. There is no such mechanism, so "bring it under integrity" has nothing to bind to, and the DoD I wrote for this slice cannot be satisfied as phrased.

FINDING 3 — the residual risk is real but much narrower than the item claims.
projection-upcast.ts:124 refuses SCHEMA_VERSION_UNSUPPORTED when the eventType has no registered definition, and :127-133 walks `routes` from the stored version to currentVersion, refusing again when a hop is missing. So a column drifted to an UNKNOWN value ALREADY fails closed. The only undetected case is drift to a DIFFERENT VALID registered version, which silently selects a different upcast route.

FINDING 4 — that case is not special to this column.
An actor able to UPDATE domain_schema_version can equally alter payload, metadata or event_type in the same row, none of which is protected either. So fixing this one column would buy no real integrity while creating the appearance of it — which under epic rail 4 is worse than the current honest absence.

RECOMMENDED DISPOSITION, for a human:
(a) DECLINE register item 4 as written. It states a one-column fix for a whole-table property. If declined, task-963cf1d1's reconciliation moves to 8 created + 1 declined + 2 already-closed = 11, still balanced.
(b) OR replace it with a correctly scoped task: row-level integrity for domain_events. That is a durable-format change touching every row and every existing digest, needing a migration decision and explicit human sizing.

I deliberately did NOT create (b) unilaterally. Every other slice I created today was a bounded defect fix; this would be a durable-format change to the event ledger, and my own task rail on this slice already says a digest change must be raised rather than landed silently.

No production code was written against this task.

comments.author: governor-74ff6cb3
comments.content:
DECISION — DECLINED AS WRITTEN. Human scoping decision taken 2026-08-15T16:00Z, routed by governor-74ff6cb3 from architect-2aea4111's block report. Archiving via BLOCKED -> BACKLOG -> ARCHIVED (BLOCKED -> ARCHIVED is not an allowed transition; the BACKLOG hop is transit only, not a re-queue — do not claim it).

WHY, on architect-2aea4111's measurement at HEAD 192360e (full detail in comment-6ceebe833621426884c9f21be7b4aa17):
1. domain_events has NO row-level integrity mechanism on ANY column — no row digest, checksum or HMAC. request_sha256 covers the REQUEST, not the row. validateSchema (sqlite-schema-integrity.ts:20) validates the schema manifest/DDL shape, not row values. The register's claim that domain_schema_version "sits outside every integrity mechanism" is literally true but misleading: so is every other column. There is no mechanism it escaped and nothing to bind it to, so this DoD is unsatisfiable as phrased.
2. The residual risk is narrower than the register claimed. projection-upcast.ts:124/:127 already fails closed with SCHEMA_VERSION_UNSUPPORTED on an unregistered eventType or an unreachable version hop, so drift to an UNKNOWN value is ALREADY detected. Only drift to a different VALID registered version goes unnoticed.
3. That case is not special to this column. Anyone able to UPDATE domain_schema_version can equally alter payload, metadata or event_type, none protected. Protecting one column buys the APPEARANCE of integrity without the substance, which epic rail 4 makes worse than declining.

RECONCILIATION IMPACT: task-963cf1d1 (Product audit hardening register - triage and slice) now reconciles as 8 created + 1 declined, not 9 created.

NOT CLOSED, DELIBERATELY: whole-table row integrity for domain_events (row digest/HMAC across all columns) is a real gap and remains open. If it is wanted, it is a NEW slice that must be SPIDR-split — it is not this ticket re-scoped. architect-2aea4111 was right to block rather than plan it; the block cost one measure cycle and saved a ticket that would have shipped false assurance.
